scripts.predev: powershell -Command "Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 3000,3001,3002 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | ForEach-Object { Stop-Process -Id $_.OwningProcess -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }; exit 0"
scripts.stop: powershell -Command "Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 3000,3001,3002 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | ForEach-Object { Stop-Process -Id $_.OwningProcess -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }; Write-Host 'Ports 3000-3002 cleaned.'; exit 0"
